# GuildTabardVote (Gildenwappen-Abstimmung)

**Live- & mehrtägige Gildenwappen-Abstimmung direkt im Spiel — entwickelt für World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface `16001`) sowie Classic & Retail.**

---

## Installation (Deutsch)

### Option 1: 1-Klick-Updater via PowerShell (am schnellsten!)
Kopiere diese eine Zeile in PowerShell (oder tippe im Spiel `/wappen update`):
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DaWasteh/WoW-Forever-GuildTabardVote/main/update.ps1 | iex
```
Das Skript findet deinen `WoW: Forever`-Ordner automatisch, lädt das neueste GitHub-Release herunter und installiert es direkt in `Interface\AddOns\GuildTabardVote`. Danach in WoW einfach `/reload`!

### Option 2: Direkt per ZIP (manuell)
1. Öffne die [aktuelle Release-Seite](https://github.com/DaWasteh/WoW-Forever-GuildTabardVote/releases/latest).
2. Lade unten bei **Assets** die Datei **`GuildTabardVote-vX.X.zip`** herunter.
3. Entpacke die ZIP-Datei und kopiere den Ordner **`GuildTabardVote`** direkt in deinen WoW: Forever AddOn-Ordner:
   - Standardpfad Windows: `C:\Program Files (x86)\World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\GuildTabardVote`
   - *(Falls du WoW auf einer anderen Festplatte installiert hast, entsprechend in `...\World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\GuildTabardVote`.)*
4. Stelle sicher, dass im Ordner `GuildTabardVote` direkt die Datei `GuildTabardVote.toc` liegt (nicht doppelt verschachtelt wie `GuildTabardVote\GuildTabardVote\`).
5. Starte **WoW: Forever** neu — fertig! Im Spiel kannst du sofort mit `/wappen test` prüfen, ob alles läuft.

> **Hinweis zur CurseForge-App:** Manuell in `Interface\AddOns\` entpackte Addons werden von der CurseForge-App nicht überschrieben und funktionieren ganz normal im Spiel. Sobald das Addon auch auf CurseForge freigeschaltet ist, kann es dort direkt per Suche installiert und automatisch aktualisiert werden.

### Option 2: Über WowUp (mit Auto-Updates direkt von GitHub)
1. Öffne **WowUp** und wähle **WoW: Forever**.
2. Klicke auf **„Install from URL“** (Aus URL installieren).
3. Füge diese Repository-URL ein:
   `https://github.com/DaWasteh/WoW-Forever-GuildTabardVote`
4. Fertig — WowUp installiert automatisch das neueste GitHub-Release und hält es aktuell.

---

## Installation (English)

### Option 1: Direct ZIP Download (Recommended)
1. Go to the [latest release page](https://github.com/DaWasteh/WoW-Forever-GuildTabardVote/releases/latest).
2. Under **Assets**, download **`GuildTabardVote-vX.X.zip`**.
3. Extract the archive and place the **`GuildTabardVote`** folder inside your WoW: Forever AddOns directory:
   `...\World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\GuildTabardVote`
4. Restart **WoW: Forever** and run `/wappen test` to try it out.

### Option 2: Via WowUp (Auto-Updates from GitHub)
1. Open **WowUp**, select **WoW: Forever**, and click **Install from URL**.
2. Paste `https://github.com/DaWasteh/WoW-Forever-GuildTabardVote` and confirm.

---

## Features (Deutsch)

- **Designs speichern & laden (Gildenmeister & Mitglieder):** Speichere beliebig viele eigene oder vorgeschlagene Wappen-Designs mit Namen (accountweit gespeichert), sieh sie jederzeit als 2D-Miniaturvorschau, lade sie per Klick in den Designer oder direkt ins offizielle Wappenmeister-Menü und reiche sie direkt in laufende Abstimmungen ein.
- **Zeitlich begrenzte Abstimmungen über X Tage:** Der Gildenmeister kann eine mehrtägige Abstimmung starten (z. B. 1, 3, 7 oder beliebig viele X Tage, plus `1Std` zum Testen). Bis zum Ablauf der Frist synchronisiert sich die Wahl automatisch beim Einloggen über die Gilde — jedes Mitglied kann alle Designs ansehen, eigene Designs einreichen, pro Design mit Daumen hoch/runter abstimmen oder sich enthalten.
- **100 % anonym & Auswertung nur für den Gildenmeister:** Sowohl Gildenmeister als auch alle Gildenmitglieder sehen **alle eingereichten Designs** in 2D & 3D. Die **Stimmenanzahl pro Design** (Daumen hoch / runter / Enthalten) sieht jedoch **ausschließlich der Gildenmeister** — und zwar vollständig **anonym** (ohne Spielernamen, über zufällige anonyme Wahl-Tokens).
- **Live-Modus am Gildenwappenmeister:** Sobald der Gildenmeister beim NPC das Wappenmenü öffnet (oder `/wappen start` nutzt), erhalten online befindliche Gildenmitglieder automatisch die Anfrage **„Mitentscheiden“** oder **„Enthalten“** und sehen alle Änderungen live in 3D & 2D.
- **1-Klick-Übernahme:** Der Gildenmeister kann jedes gespeicherte Design, jeden Live-Vorschlag und das Sieger-Design einer Zeit-Abstimmung per Klick auf **„Übernehmen“** direkt auf das offizielle Wappenmeister-Fenster laden!
- **Interaktive 3D-Vorschau:** Linksklick ziehen zum Drehen, Mausrad zum Zoomen, Rechtsklick ziehen zum Verschieben + Reset-Button.
- **Solo-Testmodus (`/wappen test`):** Teste alle Modi (Live-Wahl, X-Tage-Wahl, anonyme GM-Auswertung & gespeicherte Designs) sofort alleine!

## Features (English)

- **Save & Load Designs:** Save unlimited custom or submitted designs with names, load them into the 3D/2D designer or Guild Registrar with 1 click, or submit them directly to active votes.
- **Timed Multi-Day Polls (X Days):** Guild Masters can launch timed votes lasting X days with automatic guild-wide login sync, countdown timers, member submissions, and winner announcements.
- **Anonymous & GM-Only Vote Counts:** Everyone can view all submitted designs in 3D & 2D, submit their own designs, and vote Thumbs Up / Thumbs Down or Abstain. Vote tallies per design are strictly anonymous (no voter names) and visible exclusively to the Guild Master.
- **Live Tabard Registrar Sync:** Automatically invites online guild members when the Guild Master opens the Guild Tabard Vendor (`TabardFrame`) and streams every change live.

## Befehle / Slash Commands

| Befehl / Command | Funktion |
| --- | --- |
| `/wappen` (oder `/gwa`, `/gtv`) | Fenster öffnen (Gilden-Designs, Zeit-Wahl, Designer & GM-Auswertung) |
| `/wappen gm` | Eigenes Gildenmeister-Auswertungsmenü (anonymes Ranking & Stimmen-Sync) öffnen |
| `/wappen start` | Leiter-Panel überall öffnen (Live-Wahl, X-Tage-Zeit-Wahl & Gespeichert) |
| `/wappen stop` | Aktive Live-Abstimmung beenden |
| `/wappen test` | Solo-Testmodus (Leiter-, GM- & Mitglieder-Ansicht testen) |
| `/wappen auto` | Auto-Start beim Gildenwappenmeister an-/ausschalten |
| `/wappen update` | 1-Klick-Update-Befehl von GitHub anzeigen |
| `/wappen status` | Diagnose (Version, Rang, Sync & Stimmen) im Chat anzeigen |
| `/wappen help` | Hilfe im Chat anzeigen |

# Changelog

## v0.4 (2026-11-23)

### Dedicated Guild Master Results Menu & Reliable Throttled Sync
- **New Dedicated Guild Master Zusatzmenü (`UI_GMMenu.lua` — „GM-Auswertung“):**
  - Prominent gold **„GM-Auswertung (N)“** button right in the top bar of `/wappen` (and `/wappen gm` slash command, plus **„Auswertung“** button in the Leader Panel), visible **strictly to the Guild Master** (and in `/wappen test`).
  - Opens a full-size ranked anonymous leaderboard of ALL submitted guild designs (`#1`, `#2`, `#3`...) with 2D thumbnails, big green/red split vote bars per design, clear `Hoch / Runter / Score / Gesamt` counts, overall KPI strip (`Designs / Wähler / Enthalten`), **„3D ansehen“**, **„Übernehmen“**, **„Merken“**, **„Stimmen leeren“**, and **„Sieger melden“**.
  - When the Guild Master runs `/wappen` and designs already exist, the dedicated GM Results overview opens automatically alongside the main window.
- **Fixed Dropped Votes Under WoW Addon Message Throttling (`Protocol.lua`):**
  - Replaced unthrottled fire-and-forget `C_ChatInfo.SendAddonMessage` bursts (which silently dropped `GB_BALLOT` votes when Blizzard returned `AddonMessageThrottle` / `ChannelThrottle`!) with a **reliable priority send queue** that checks `SendAddonMessageResult` and automatically retries throttled messages with backoff.
  - Prioritized sending anonymous ballots (`GB_BALLOT`) BEFORE deletion tombstones (`GB_DEL`) during snapshots.
  - Added 1-click **„Stimmen abrufen“ (`GB_SYNC_REQ`)** button in the GM Results menu so the Guild Master can immediately pull every online guild member's anonymous ballot (1 tiny packet per member) with a live response counter!
- **Stopped Accidental Live Invite Spam:** Opening the standalone Leader Panel no longer auto-broadcasts a Live Session invite until the GM actually clicks **„Live starten“**.
- **Diagnostics Command (`/wappen status`):** Prints addon version, guild name, rank, `IsGuildLeader` detection, registered prefix, active scope, design/voter counts, and send queue length for instant troubleshooting.

## v0.3 (2026-11-23)

- Cross-realm canonical `"BOARD"` scope, checksum-based peer sync, atomic `GB_BALLOT` replication, and test-mode cleanup.

## v0.2 (2026-11-23)

- Always-open persistent Guild Design Board, native clickable vote buttons, inline toast feedback, and `/wappen update` + `update.ps1`.

## v0.1 (2026-11-23)

- Initial release for World of Warcraft: Forever (`16001`).

releases.notes:
# Changelog

## v0.3 (2026-11-23)

### Guild Master Vote Visibility & Edge-Case Bugfixes
- **Fixed Guild Master Missing Vote Counts per Design (Cross-Realm & Scope Fix):**
  - Replaced realm-specific `"<Guild-Realm>_board"` scope IDs with a canonical cross-realm-safe `"BOARD"` scope (with automatic migration of legacy v0.2 votes), fixing cases where connected-realm members' votes were stored under a different scope than the Guild Master's.
  - Carrying over existing board votes automatically when the Guild Master starts a Timed Poll with *"Bisherige Gilden-Designs behalten"* checked (and mirroring in-flight `"BOARD"` votes cleanly).
  - Hardened `GTV:IsGuildLeader()` with `C_GuildInfo.GuildRoster()` and `C_GuildInfo.GetGuildRankOrder` fallback so GM detection works reliably right after login.
- **Crystal-Clear Anonymous GM Vote Display:**
  - Every design row now shows a clear anonymous GM vote badge (`+Up / -Down (Total)`) with hover tooltip in BOTH the **Leader Panel** and the **Member Window** (strictly hidden from regular members!).
  - Added an anonymous GM summary header (`GM (anonym): Wähler: X | Enthalten: Y`) above the Guild Designs list for the Guild Master.
- **Checksum-Based Peer Sync & Atomic Ballot Replication (`GB_BALLOT`):**
  - Replaced count-only `GB_HELLO` checks (which missed votes whenever two peers happened to have the same voter count or voted on multiple designs) with a deterministic content checksum over all designs, deletions, and individual votes.
  - Packed per-voter ballots (`GB_BALLOT` with monotonic revision) now sync vote additions, switches (`UP <-> DOWN`), removals (`NONE`), abstentions, and design deletions (`GB_DEL` tombstones) cleanly across offline/online sessions.
- **Fixed Lingering Solo Test Mode Edge Case:** Closing `/wappen test` or opening `/wappen` / `/wappen start` / Guild Registrar now cleanly exits test mode so real guild sync and GM vote counts resume immediately without requiring `/reload`.
- **Fixed Delayed Login Guild Sync:** Guild sync now waits until `GetGuildInfo("player")` is actually populated (`GUILD_ROSTER_UPDATE` / `PLAYER_GUILD_UPDATE`) rather than marking synced prematurely.

## v0.2 (2026-11-23)

- Always-open persistent Guild Design Board so every guild member can submit designs and view all guild designs anytime.
- Native clickable `Button` widgets for Thumbs Up / Thumbs Down, inline visual toast feedback, and 3D `EnsureReady` tab-switch reset fix.
- `/wappen update` command + `update.ps1` 1-click GitHub updater + automatic in-game version check.

## v0.1 (2026-11-23)

- Initial release of **GuildTabardVote** for **World of Warcraft: Forever** (`16001`).

releases.notes:
# Changelog

## v0.2 (2026-11-23)

### Bugfixes & Major UX Improvements
- **Always-Open Persistent Guild Design Board:** Any guild member can now submit designs to their guild at ANY time (no longer blocked when the Guild Master hasn't started a live/timed session yet!). Every guild member automatically sees ALL submitted guild designs in the right-hand **Gilden-Designs** panel, persisted in `SavedVariables` and synced automatically peer-to-peer on login/open.
- **Fixed Non-Responsive Buttons:**
  - Replaced `Frame`-based vote boxes with native clickable `Button` widgets (`OnClick`) for **Daumen hoch** & **Daumen runter**.
  - Big **Daumen hoch / Daumen runter** buttons now work on BOTH active Live Leader sessions AND any selected Guild Design from the list!
  - **An Gilde senden** (Submit to Guild) and **Lokal speichern** (Save Locally) now work reliably at all times with clear inline visual toast feedback inside the window.
- **Fixed Tab Switching & 3D Load Reset:** `TabardModel:EnsureReady()` no longer calls `SetUnit("player")` repeatedly on tab switches or before `SeekModel()`, preventing loaded/previewed designs from being reset.
- **Design Management:** Authors and Guild Masters can delete submitted designs (`X`) with synced tombstones (`GB_DEL`). Added a 1-click **Leiter-Panel** shortcut button in the header for Guild Masters.
- **1-Click GitHub Updater (`/wappen update` + `update.ps1`):** Automatic in-game guild version check notifies when a newer version is available, and `/wappen update` opens a copy-ready PowerShell 1-liner (`irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DaWasteh/WoW-Forever-GuildTabardVote/main/update.ps1 | iex`) that auto-detects WoW: Forever and installs the latest GitHub release.

## v0.1 (2026-11-23)

First public release of **GuildTabardVote** for **World of Warcraft: Forever** (Interface `16001`).

# Changelog

## v0.1 (2026-11-23)

First public release of **GuildTabardVote** for **World of Warcraft: Forever** (Interface `16001`, plus Classic & Retail multi-version TOC support `11509`, `20506`, `120105`).

### Features
- **Live Guild Tabard Sync & Voting:** Automatically invites online guild members (*Mitentscheiden* / *Enthalten*) when the Guild Master opens the Guild Tabard Registrar (`TabardFrame`) or runs `/wappen start`, streaming emblem, border, and background changes live to participating members' 3D character models and 2D previews.
- **Timed Multi-Day Guild Votes (X Days):** Guild Masters can create timed guild votes lasting X days (or quick presets `1h`, `1d`, `3d`, `7d`) with a live countdown, automatic login sync across the guild, peer relay for offline votes, and winner announcement.
- **Strictly Anonymous & Guild-Master-Only Vote Results:** All guild members and the Guild Master see **all** submitted designs in 3D & 2D, submit their own designs, and vote Thumbs Up / Thumbs Down or Abstain — while vote counts per design are strictly **anonymous** (random per-poll voter tokens, never player names) and visible **only to the Guild Master**.
- **Save & Load Designs:** Account-wide design library (`SavedVariables`) for both Guild Masters and Guild Members — save any design with a custom name, load it back into the 3D/2D designer or directly onto the Guild Registrar with 1 click, or submit saved designs into an active vote.
- **Interactive 3D Tabard Viewer:** Centered, enlarged `TabardModel` with unified left-drag rotate, right-drag pan, mouse-wheel zoom, and camera reset.
- **Solo Test Mode (`/wappen test`):** Test Live Mode, X-Day Timed Votes, anonymous GM counts, and Saved Designs solo.
- **Full Localization:** German (`deDE`) and English (`enUS`).
